newsitem.title: USA: BEFORE THE BELL - Advanta in early freefall.
newsitem.headline: BEFORE THE BELL - Advanta in early freefall.

text.p: Advanta Corp's pre-announcement of first quarter earnings "well below" expectations and its hiring of an investment bank knocked the shares down sharply in Monday pre-open activity, traders said.
The stock fell to 33 from 40-3/8 in busy trade, they said.
Advanta, a financial services company active in the credit card and home equity loan markets, said it expects to report a first quarter loss of $0.44 per share.
Advanta also said its chief operating office resigned from the company after two months on the job, and it has hired BT Wolfensohn review the company's operations.
